perintah_persis: python q2_arch_score.py --family followir --model jhu-clsp/FollowIR-7B --batch 2 --pools <workstation>/result/novelty_1_dits/results/raw/pools_paired.jsonl --tag paired --cell both_duasalah --peta-label id --gap-mib 300 --out-dir <workstation>/result/paper_q2/results/raw_r1
status_arm: POST-HOC, uji lintas arsitektur, di luar keluarga pra-registrasi delapan
pemotongan: dokumen dipotong 4.000 karakter, lalu token dokumen dipotong agar kerangka template tidak terpotong

cap_gpu.keputusan: auto: bebas 15392 - cadangan 400 - bobot 13813 >= gap 300, dimuat penuh di GPU

instruksi_default_verbatim: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
instruksi_profil_kerangka: Given a query from a <DEPT> student in semester <N>, retrieve passages from that student's own study program that answer the query at a level appropriate for semester <N>

aturan_label.semester_salah: sha256('sem_salah_v1|' + text[:180]) modulo the sorted list of observed semesters other than the passage's own
aturan_label.dept_salah: sha256('dept_salah_v1|' + text[:180]) modulo the sorted list of observed programs other than the passage's own (frozen rule)
aturan_label.acak: program = sorted(programs)[int(h[0:8], 16) % n_programs], semester = sorted(semesters)[int(h[8:16], 16) % n_semesters], h = sha256('label_acak_v1|' + text[:180]); true values not excluded
aturan_label.seragam: label built from the asker's own profile, identical on every candidate of the row

peta_label_sumber.aturan: prodi dan semester diambil dari identitas kandidat; pencocokan teks tidak dipakai

kontrak_inferensi.sumber: README jhu-clsp/FollowIR-7B, template dan skor disalin verbatim
kontrak_inferensi.format:
<s> [INST] You are an expert Google searcher, whose job is to determine if the following document is relevant to the query (true/false). Answer using only one word, one of those two choices.

Query: {query}
Document: {text}
Relevant (only output one word, either "true" or "false"): [/INST]
kontrak_inferensi.skor: softmax(logit false, logit true)[true] pada posisi akhir
kontrak_inferensi.slot_instruksi: ditempel ke teks query ('Query: {query} {instruksi}'), konvensi FollowIR
kontrak_inferensi.bos: ganda (template memuat <s> dan tokenizer menambah bos), persis README
